meta.name: applescript
meta.description: Write and run safe AppleScript automation on macOS with dictionary discovery, robust quoting, and deterministic read-first workflows.

copy.tagline: 用 AppleScript 自动操作 macOS 应用和系统功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用脚本控制 Mac 上的应用和系统
copy.tagline_en: Automate macOS apps and system features with AppleScript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control Mac apps and system with scripts

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude可以在macOS上编写并安全运行AppleScript脚本，帮助你控制应用、提取数据或自动化界面操作。它会在编写脚本前先读取应用词典，并强制执行先读后写、双重确认等安全规则。
howto.when: 当你提出需要在macOS上自动化操作某个应用、提取数据或执行脚本化界面操作时，Claude会主动启用此技能。

say.text: 用AppleScript帮我自动打开邮件并发送一封测试邮件。
say.note: Claude会先读取邮件应用词典再编写脚本。

say.text: 在Mac上自动控制Safari浏览器，打开我指定的网页。
say.note: Claude会执行安全脚本并请求确认。

say.text: 帮我用AppleScript获取当前正在播放的歌曲信息。
say.note: Claude使用字典发现确保脚本正确。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can write and safely run AppleScript automation on macOS. It helps control apps, extract data, or automate UI actions by first inspecting the app's dictionary and following deterministic workflows.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when you ask to automate an app, extract data, or perform scripted UI actions on macOS.

say_en.text: Use AppleScript to open Mail and send a test email.
Automate Safari to open a specific webpage.
say_en.note: Claude will execute safely with confirmation.

say_en.text: Get the currently playing track info using AppleScript.
